status: Protocol review sequences only; no live subscription, transport, timing or page-assembly oracle executed

cases.requirement: Both clients assemble exactly rows0..2 of snapshot-one with one stamp, then apply the complete exact-base delta atomically. No one-page claim of full grid.

With zero pages or zero bytes available, publish no presentation page/delta; bounded control notices use a separately reserved control allowance. Replenishment cannot exceed negotiated outstanding caps.
Before sending, charge complete UTF-8 encoded envelope bytes and one page. If a single page cannot fit, refuse/reduce page under the same snapshot binding; never exceed credit or truncate it.

Missing exactbase, dropped presentation frame, expired cursor, replaced target or policy/buffer/geometry drift invalidates pending assembly; request current snapshot. No output-parser gap can be repaired by resnapshot.

Cancel releases retained pages/cursors after closure and fences further publication. Already received frames remain historical. Disconnect closes subscription; resumed read authenticates, authorizes and verifies exact cursor/base or resnapshots, without restoring writer ownership or retrying input.

Reject a page with another snapshot/stamp/session, overlapping/missing rows, duplicate row IDs, wrong active width, changed total or inconsistent metadata. Discard incomplete assembly on expiration; never display it as a full snapshot.

Presentation includes active cells and authorized cursor/facts only; inactive buffer/parser continuations/receipts/grants are absent. It is not complete semantic state, evidence of OS readiness, or an import/recovery image.
